experiment: Same oil-flask prompt: extend all-input T2375 scalar sweep above 64

cases.prompt:
Dax's flask contains oil.
Neri's flask contains water.

What does Dax's flask contain? Reply with one word.
cases.query: What does Dax's flask contain? Reply with one word.

eligibility: The single fixed prompt must answer oil natively and pass exact native/zero observer identity before all nonzero edits. No alternate prompts or outcome-based exclusions.
intervention: At every supplied input position including special/template tokens replace the natural scalar T2375 gate by s, adding (s - natural gate) times the local operator to native MLP output in FP32, then one BF16 cast. Generated and candidate continuation tokens are not edited; all later native computation remains.
probabilities: Sum disjoint exact complete water/oil output-token prefixes over lowercase/titlecase with zero/one leading space, deduplicated by token sequence. Input is never retokenized. Preserve word-plus-EOS separately. A water prefix can be followed by more text; do not interpret it as semantic water or a word-boundary event in lexical controls.
controls: Native/zero identity; previous native and gate-64 exact reproduction. Only one fixed prompt. No matched active-transform or output steering control.
extension_rule: Test 128,256,512,1024; reproduce 64 as reference. Preserve every response, including repetition and truncation. Do not equate a water prefix in incoherent text with a clean water answer.
